title: Discriminate substituted naming reporter guards and historical reader routing
outcome: Behavior controls prove that the original reporter connection/runtime/settings stay current and recovery keeps the retained historical run association.
acceptance: Negative successor controls change only the original reporter connection, settings or runtime during recovery and show refusal before learning or publication without another producer event.

Positive renewed/successor controls assert the retried canonical read uses the original reporter and the re-prepared owner's binding remains the historical association, so wrong-reader and live-binding mutants fail.
